title: Counterfactual neighbor-identity specificity of signed node-to-graph transfer

target_design.cutoff_rule: For target i, compute field and graph from draws[:i], freeze every ranking, then read draw i.

hypothesis: Q88 transfer should depend on the true mapping from graph neighbors to their prior six-feature states. Randomly reassigned neighbor-feature labels should weaken identity-specific signal if that mapping matters. A graph-free node-inertia control tests whether graph information adds anything beyond node autoregression.

identity_operator.definition: Frozen Q88 operator: base_z + 0.20*0.5*(reversion+graph_signal)*z(EWMA20,0.80 signed cosine(node_delta_i, edge_delta_i @ prior_neighbor_features / sqrt(39))).

counterfactuals.generator: Python random.Random MT19937; sample(range(40),40); 39 unique non-identity permutations plus identity at index 0.
counterfactuals.mapping: Permute only rows of prior neighbor-feature matrix; do not modify edge_delta. Graph edge weights and every row strength remain unchanged.

node_only_control.definition: Signed cosine between current and previous six-feature node deltas; EWMA20 decay .80; score base_z + .20*reversion*z(node_inertia); no graph input.

selection: No candidate selection or parameter tuning. Q88 identity formula, 39 counterfactual mappings and node-only control are fixed before execution.

statistics.exact_null: Global Holm across 42 models x 3 splits x 3 endpoints = 378 tests using iid Hypergeometric(40,k,5) upper-tail convolution.
statistics.paired: Moving-block bootstrap block 20, 2,000 replications; 24 tests on Validation/Blind OOS across permutation mean, node-only and Equal42, Top5/Top10/Top20/mean actual rank; one global Holm family.
statistics.randomization: Monte Carlo p=(1 + number of 39 permuted split means >= identity split mean)/40; 9 tests across 3 splits x 3 endpoints; one global Holm family.
statistics.primary_gate: Historical Blind OOS identity must lift Top20 >=0.10 versus Equal42 with paired CI lower >0 and paired Holm p<0.05 and exact-null Holm p<0.05; it must also beat permutation-mean with paired CI lower >0, paired Holm p<0.05 and neighbor-randomization Holm p<0.05.

safeguards: Strict-prior cutoff per target; rankings frozen before reading target quintet.
Permutation family and hash fixed before outcomes; no result-dependent resampling.
Edge-delta matrix is unchanged; edge weights and row strengths are exactly preserved.
No Validation or Blind OOS tuning.
Independent validator replays every cutoff, signal, ranking and multiplicity family.
Historical Blind OOS is already exposed and exploratory, not virgin holdout.
No freeze modification, prospective shadow insertion, engine promotion or automatic merge.
